record.context_brief: Blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces and pseudo-effective tangent bundles
record.original_question: Does the blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface at four general points have pseudo-effective tangent bundle, and what can be said about blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces at special points?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.6. Does the blow-up of Hirzebruch surfaces at general four points have the pseudo-effective tangent bundle?
What can we say for the blow-up of Hirzebruch surfaces at special points?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}_n = \mathbb{P}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1} \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(n))$ denote the $n$-th Hirzebruch surface, where $n \geq 0$. A vector bundle $E$ on a smooth projective variety $X$ is called pseudo-effective if the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(E)}(1)$ on the projectivization $\mathbb{P}(E)$ is pseudo-effective (i.e., its numerical class lies in the closure of the cone of effective $\mathbb{R}$-divisors), and the union of those fibers of $\mathbb{P}(E) \to X$ contained in the stable base locus of $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(E)}(1)$ is not Zariski dense in $\mathbb{P}(E)$.

(a) Let $X$ be the blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface $\mathbb{F}_n$ at four points in general position. Determine whether the tangent bundle $T_X$ is pseudo-effective.

(b) More generally, characterize for which configurations of (special) points $p_1, \ldots, p_k$ on a Hirzebruch surface $\mathbb{F}_n$ the blow-up of $\mathbb{F}_n$ at $p_1, \ldots, p_k$ has pseudo-effective tangent bundle.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work establishes that the blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface at three general points has (strongly) pseudo-effective tangent bundle, and there are characterizations of pseudo-effective tangent bundles for non-uniruled surfaces via $K_S$ nef and $c_2(S)=0$. However, the explicit case of four general points on a Hirzebruch surface, and the general case of special-point configurations, do not appear to be resolved in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Smooth projective surfaces with pseudo-effective tangent bundles
status_evidence.snippet: We study the blow-up of a non-rational ruled surface with pseudo-effective tangent bundle.
status_evidence.claim: Related research addresses pseudo-effective tangent bundles of blow-ups of ruled surfaces but does not explicitly resolve the four-general-points case for Hirzebruch surfaces.

status_evidence.title: On compact Kähler manifold with strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: The blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface along general three points has a strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle.
status_evidence.claim: The three-general-points case is resolved positively, leaving the four-general-points case as the next natural open question.
